Compute Match — Identity and Keycloak
Realm and clients
Single realm: customer  (organizations enabled). Older provider/operations realm ﬁles exist but
the application uses one uniﬁed realm.
Local realm export: keycloak/realms/local-realm-customer.json .
Main clients: customer-web  (frontend OIDC), workflow-worker  (Temporal service account),
audit-listener , superset , swagger , temporal-ui .
Identity broker Starﬂeet (NVIDIA SSO) with a starfleet-roles  mapper. The frontend sends
kc_idp_hint=starfleet .
Roles
customer , provider , provider_business_user , provider_basic_user , platform_business_admin ,
platform_business_admin_super_user , platform_business_admin_ops_user , account_manager_consumer ,
account_manager_provider , superset_users , superset_admins , superset_dashboard_viewers , plus the
composite default-roles-customer .
Groups used by the app: offering-validator  (magic-link recipients), mailing-list .
Custom extensions (keycloak-extensions/ )
Extension What it does
accept-reservation-token Custom action token for magic links: validates the
JWT, blocks a different logged-in user, validates
the nonce with the backend, creates the session
and redirects. Exposes the token-minting REST
endpoint with a rate limiter
audit-event-listener Sends LOGIN and LOGOUT events (and errors) to
the backend
/api/v1/internal/audit/keycloak-event
default-role-restriction Self-signup users keep default-roles-
customer ; admin-created users have defaults
stripped
multi-org-policy Only account-manager roles may belong to more
than one organization
Build with keycloak-extensions/build.sh ; images from keycloak/Dockerfile  and keycloak/Dockerfile-
local .
Themes
The NVIDIA theme lives in keycloak/themes/nvidia/  (login, account, admin, email). The login theme
extends keycloak.v2  and adds organization-type registration ﬁelds (enterprise, government,
sme_msme, startup).
Organizations
Keycloak Organizations model NCP and customer companies.
NCP organization names come from the Salesforce account name; one organization per
Salesforce account.
The organization  JWT claim carries the user’s organization; the backend stores matching
organization records.
Local Keycloak
Admin console: http://localhost:8080/admin , realm customer .
Management/health port: host 9001.
Admin credentials are generated into local-setup/.onboarding/credentials.json .
